results.original: A small transformer uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training. Regularization helps it generalize beyond its training examples. After training, quantization reduces its memory requirements, while retrieval-augmented generation lets it use external documents when answering questions.
results.reconstruction: A small transformer uses self attention to process text and employs backpropagation during training to improve predictions of the small transformer. Regularization enables generalization beyond training examples for the small transformer, while quantization reduces memory requirements of the small transformer after training. Retrieval augmented generation lets the small transformer use external documents when answering questions.

All participant roles, conditions (e.g., 'during training', 'after training'), modality (none), and argument qualifiers were preserved without inferring facts or turning qualified goals into achieved results.
